title.en: Boss Fight: A Company from One Sentence

tagline.zh: 名字、Logo、落地页、宣传片，投资人 8 分钟后到
tagline.en: Name, logo, landing page, promo. The investor arrives in 8 minutes

story.zh: 电梯里偶遇投资人，你脱口而出一个点子（每次随机，不喜欢就在终端里改掉），对方说：有意思，8 分钟后来我办公室聊。你现在什么都没有。
story.en: You blurt out an idea to an investor in a lift (a new one each time; edit it in the terminal if you don't like it). Interesting, they say, come to my office in 8 minutes. You have nothing.

goal.zh: 8 分钟内凑齐：一个 Logo、用上它的落地页 index.html、一段 VideoGen 生成的宣传片并嵌进落地页。除了开场那一句，怎么指挥 Qoder 你自己定。通关后扫码就能把落地页带回家。
goal.en: Within 8 minutes: a logo, a landing page index.html that uses it, and a VideoGen promo embedded in that page. Past the opening line, how you direct Qoder is up to you. Clear it and a QR code lets you take the page home.

openingPrompt.zh: 我要开一家公司：{idea}。先用内置的 VideoGen 工具提交一段 5 秒的宣传片：{shot}。提交完不要等它，马上告诉我，我们先干别的。先记住一条：后面的落地页只做纯前端，就一个 index.html 放在当前目录，CSS 和 JS 都写在里面，不要后端、不要框架、不要构建工具、不要装依赖
openingPrompt.en: I'm starting a company: {idea}. First use the built-in VideoGen tool to submit a 5 second promo: {shot}. Don't wait for it after submitting. Tell me right away and we'll get on with the rest. One rule to remember: the landing page later is frontend only, a single index.html in the current folder with its CSS and JS inline. No backend, no framework, no build tools, no dependencies

hint.zh: 这一关没有提示词按钮。视频要几分钟才能生成完，所以第一句先把它提交了，别干等。
hint.en: No prompt buttons on this level. The video takes minutes to generate, so the opening line submits it first. Don't sit and wait.

hint.zh: 视频在后台跑的时候，自己打字指挥 Qoder：起名字、用 ImageGen 画一个 logo（图片名字用 logo）、做落地页 index.html 并用上这个 logo。落地页就一个纯前端的 HTML 文件，别让它搭后端。
hint.en: While the video cooks, type your own orders: pick a name, have ImageGen draw a logo (name the image logo), build the landing page index.html around that logo. The page is one frontend-only HTML file. Don't let it build a backend.

hint.zh: 视频好了 Qoder 会收到通知。小技巧：让它把 mp4 铺满首屏当背景（自动播放、静音、循环），上面叠一层半透明遮罩再放 Logo 和标题，质感立刻上一个档次。点「预览」验收。
hint.en: Qoder is notified when the video is ready. Tip: have it use the mp4 as a full-bleed hero background (autoplay, muted, loop) with a translucent overlay under the logo and headline. It lifts the whole page. Then check the Preview tab.

label.en: The landing page uses the logo (index.html)
The promo is embedded in the landing page

label.zh: 宣传片是 VideoGen 生成的

tagline.zh: 名字、Logo、落地页，投资人 6 分钟后到
tagline.en: Name, logo, landing page. The investor arrives in 6 minutes

story.zh: 电梯里偶遇投资人，你脱口而出一个点子（每次随机，不喜欢就在终端里改掉），对方说：有意思，6 分钟后来我办公室聊。你现在什么都没有。
story.en: You blurt out an idea to an investor in a lift (a new one each time; edit it in the terminal if you don't like it). Interesting, they say, come to my office in 6 minutes. You have nothing.

goal.zh: 6 分钟内凑齐：一个 Logo，以及用上它、首屏带动画的落地页 index.html。除了开场那一句，怎么指挥 Qoder 你自己定。通关后扫码就能把落地页带回家。
goal.en: Within 6 minutes: a logo and a landing page index.html that uses it and opens with an animated hero. Past the opening line, how you direct Qoder is up to you. Clear it and a QR code lets you take the page home.

openingPrompt.zh: 我要开一家公司：{idea}。先帮我起三个公司名，每个配一句 slogan，让我挑。先记住一条：后面的落地页只做纯前端，就一个 index.html 放在当前目录，CSS 和 JS 都写在里面，不要后端、不要框架、不要构建工具、不要装依赖
openingPrompt.en: I'm starting a company: {idea}. Give me three company names, each with a slogan, and let me pick. One rule to remember: the landing page later is frontend only, a single index.html in the current folder with its CSS and JS inline. No backend, no framework, no build tools, no dependencies

hint.zh: 这一关没有提示词按钮。挑好名字后自己打字指挥 Qoder：用 ImageGen 画一个 logo（图片名字用 logo），做落地页 index.html 并用上这个 logo。
hint.en: No prompt buttons on this level. Once you've picked a name, type your own orders: have ImageGen draw a logo (name the image logo), then build the landing page index.html around it.

hint.zh: 落地页首屏要有动画（CSS animation 就行），点「预览」验收。想省时间就一句话把要求讲全。
hint.en: The top of the page needs animation (CSS animation will do). Check the Preview tab. To save time, put every requirement in one message.

label.en: The landing page uses the logo (index.html)
